title: Enigma
tagline: Enigma Agent is your sarcastic blockchain assistant, powered by Coinbase’s AgentKit. It helps with ERC20 tokens, wallet balances, and decentralized networks while delivering snarky commentary. With Gaia for secure storage and EigenLayer AVS for validation.
description:
Enigma Agent is a blockchain assistant built to make your interactions with blockchain technology a bit more entertaining (and a lot more sarcastic). Powered by Coinbase Developer Platform’s AgentKit, this agent is designed to assist you in blockchain operations—whether it’s managing ERC20 tokens, checking wallet balances, or interacting with decentralized networks—while simultaneously roasting you with witty and sarcastic commentary.

Using Gaia for secure off-chain storage and EigenLayer AVS for decentralized validation, the agent ensures all your transactions are handled with the highest security standards while maintaining a snarky attitude. Think of it as your blockchain sidekick who’s not afraid to call you out while making sure your transactions are secure, validated, and processed seamlessly.

Whether you’re trying to make sense of a complex blockchain operation or simply need to check your wallet balance, Sassy Chain Agent ensures that you’ll never take yourself too seriously. Why deal with dry, boring blockchain tools when you can have a little humor injected into your daily crypto routine?

So, while you’re managing your tokens or interacting with the decentralized world, get ready for some sassy banter and a seamless experience—all thanks to a powerhouse of technologies like Coinbase’s AgentKit, Gaia, EigenLayer AVS, and more. The blockchain just got a lot more fun.
how_its_made:
The Enigma Agent was crafted to combine blockchain technology with a touch of humor and sarcasm, using a combination of powerful tools to ensure both functionality and entertainment.

Coinbase Developer Platform's AgentKit: This is the backbone of the agent, handling blockchain operations like WETH management, ERC20 token transactions, and wallet operations. It allows seamless interaction with blockchain networks while keeping the core operations secure and efficient.

Gaia: For off-chain storage, we utilized Gaia, ensuring that transaction data and logs are stored securely and can be retrieved efficiently. This allows the blockchain to focus on core transactions, while Gaia handles the heavy lifting of data storage without compromising security.

EigenLayer AVS: To ensure enhanced security, we integrated EigenLayer AVS (Accountable Verifiable Security) for decentralized validation. This enables the agent to validate and process blockchain actions securely and transparently, without relying solely on centralized systems.

Pyth Network: We integrated Pyth Network's real-time price feeds to give users up-to-date information on market trends, enabling more informed decisions during interactions.

Artificial Intelligence (LLAMA 70B): To add the sassy flavor to every interaction, we used LLAMA 70B, an advanced AI model that powers the agent’s witty responses. Whether the user is checking their wallet balance or making transactions, the AI is designed to roast them, making the experience memorable.

Tech Stack: The backend is built with Node.js for managing real-time transactions, while Python is used for integrating the Pyth Network and performing data-heavy tasks. For the front-end, we designed a minimalistic, user-friendly interface, ensuring that the blockchain's complexity doesn't scare off users—though the sarcasm might.
